symptom: A quoted attribute segment with whitespace before its `,` / `)` / `;` — the last member of a multi-line change/create with `)` on its own line, a declare with `;` on the next line, a call argument — is stored as `$Other/"C"`; mx check: CE0117 "Error(s) in expression.", mxcli check passes. The same member written with `)` on its line stores `$Other/C`.
cause: appendSourceExpressionSuffix (kept trailing whitespace for describe's layout, ako/mxcli#898) rebuilt the slot's source from raw text and skipped stripExpressionIdentifierQuotes, which every other SourceExpr path applies (#827).
insight: Layout decided which path a slot took, so the #827 fix held for every slot except the one whose delimiter sat on the next line — test a quoting fix against each SourceExpr constructor, not each statement. grep `&ast.SourceExpr{` in mdl/visitor: any constructor not wrapping its Source in stripExpressionIdentifierQuotes is a candidate. Measured on 11.12.1: unfixed build 6x CE0117 across change/create/declare/call, fixed 0, the `)`-on-last-line control clean in both.
